title: kbtail.py prints a tool call's name without redaction, so a secret-shaped MCP tool name reaches the terminal
goal: kbtail.py passes a tool call's name through the same redaction and leak scan as every other displayed string

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading, time, uuid
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg")
sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "-planted-project"); os.makedirs(pdir)
P = os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl")
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="200", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"))
def ent(text, **kw):
    return json.dumps(dict({"type": "assistant", "cwd": T, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z",
                            "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": text}]}}, **kw)) + "\n"
def tail(*a, path=None):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/kbtail.py", *a, path or P], cwd=R, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
def follow(path=None):
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "_tools/kbtail.py", "--history", "2", path or P], cwd=R, env=env,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    lines = []
    threading.Thread(target=lambda: [lines.append(x) for x in p.stdout], daemon=True).start()
    return p, lines
def until(pred, s):
    end = time.monotonic() + s
    while time.monotonic() < end and not pred():
        time.sleep(0.05)
    return pred()
import random, string
key = "sk-" + "".join(random.SystemRandom().choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(40))
with open(P, "w") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"type": "assistant", "cwd": T, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z",
                        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "toolu_1", "name": "mcp__" + key, "input": {}}]}}) + "\n")
r = tail("--once")
ok = r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip() and key[3:23] not in r.stdout
print("exit", r.returncode, "shown" if key[3:23] in r.stdout else "hidden")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
